create_database.description: Creates a new database in a group for the organization or user.
create_database.name: create_database

parameters.description: The slug of the organization or user account.
parameters.name: organization_slug

parameters.description: The name of the new database. Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, dashes. No longer than 64 characters.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The name of the group where the database should be created. The group must already exist.
parameters.name: group

parameters.description: Seed.
parameters.name: seed

name.description: The name of the existing database when database is used as a seed type.

timestamp.description: A formatted ISO 8601 recovery point to create a database from. This must be within the last 24 hours, or 30 days on the scaler plan.

type.description: The type of seed to be used to create a new database. Use database to copy from an existing database, or database_upload to upload a SQLite database file.

parameters.description: The maximum size of the database in bytes. Values with units are also accepted, e.g. 1mb, 256mb, 1gb.
parameters.name: size_limit

parameters.description: Encryption configuration for the database. Can be used when creating a new encrypted database, creating a encrypted database from upload (seed.type = "database_upload"), or forking from an encrypted database (required when the source database is encrypted).
parameters.name: remote_encryption

schema.description: Encryption configuration for the database. Can be used when creating a new encrypted database, creating a encrypted database from upload (seed.type = "database_upload"), or forking from an encrypted database (required when the source database is encrypted).

encryption_key.description: Base64-encoded encryption key. Key size depends on cipher: 32 bytes for aes256gcm, chacha20poly1305, aegis256 variants; 16 bytes for aes128gcm, aegis128l variants.

Hostname.description: The DNS hostname used for client libSQL and HTTP connections.

Name.description: The database name, unique across your organization.

top_queries.description: The top queries performed on the given database as well as the total rows read and written.

query.description: A string representing the SQL query executed.

rows_read.description: An integer indicating the number of rows read by the query, which reflects the volume of data the query processed from the database.

rows_written.description: An integer indicating the number of rows written (inserted, updated, or deleted) by the query, which reflects the impact of the query on the database data.

rows_read.description: The total rows read in the time period.

rows_written.description: The total rows written in the time period.
